title: Musicians' reputation
summary: Maxwell says musicians' glamorous reputation is undeserved.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: That's a funny thing I'd sure like to put in here, too, is the reputation musicians have got. And probably deserve less than any field of people I know. I live in -- my neighborhood's all business people. And you talk about swingers -- musicians don't even start. These guys are bombed all the time, they've got parties everynight, they're going around pinching everybody else's wife's butt. Some musician did that and he'd get knocked across the room, in our circle.
And then they come and they say, oh, you guys must
lead a real glamorous life, you get all these broads and everything. I don't think I've met a broad in the last 20 years.
If I did, I wouldn't know what to do.
Yeah, that's the reputation we have. And the stigma is still there.
